purpose: Teach: カーター/ジョブズ/ナイジェリア/アルメニア/プラトン/ユング/ラテンアメリカ/ローマ法王

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカーター元大統領のドキュメンタリーをご覧になったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad watched that documentary about former President Carter.
lines.style: Warm, conversational, as if sharing something she found interesting. Gentle rise on Sho's name. Natural pace, no hurry. The tone of someone relaying news with affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとジョブズの本読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a book about Jobs!
lines.style: Bright, quick energy. Opening syllable hits with genuine excitement. Slight breathiness — he wants her to understand how cool this was. Small-kid enthusiasm without performed cuteness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがナイジェリア駐在のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he'll tell you about his time stationed in Nigeria.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal register — matching the tone of what the father apparently said. Gentle, almost deferential. Slow enough to let the importance land. Soft trailing-off on the period.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとアルメニアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Armenia!
lines.style: Same bright eagerness as before. Quick tempo. That small, genuine laugh-edge in his voice — he's proud of what he experienced. Open vowels, no self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがプラトンの哲学のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to talk to you about Plato's philosophy.
lines.style: Reflective but with quiet delight underneath. She appreciates that the father does these things for Sho. Measured pace. Respectful of the weight of the topic while keeping it warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ユング心理学って何?お父さんに聞くね
lines.en: Mei-sis, what is Jungian psychology? I'm going to ask Dad!
lines.style: Curious, not quite sure but unafraid to wonder aloud. Slight pause before the question mark — genuinely puzzled. Uptick of hope on the final phrase — he knows Dad will explain. Perceptive kid, not showing off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラテンアメリカの音楽聴かせて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad played some Latin American music for me.
lines.style: Wistful, nostalgic warmth. She's holding the memory of that moment. Slower pace, almost reverent. Soft attack on the opening, lingering slightly on 'music' as if the melody is still in her ears.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとローマ法王の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a picture book about the Pope!
lines.style: Same eager brightness as the other Sho lines, but slightly more settled — he's coming to the end of his share. Still genuine excitement, but a tiny bit of natural winding-down in pace. Warm close.
